subject: english
question:
**Direction: Complete the sentence with the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets.**

Tell everyone to clear the ______ (**hallway**) as the bride and her father have arrived.
solution: The correct answer is **"aisle."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hallway" **means a space or passage inside the entrance or front door of a building. (किसी भवन के प्रवेश द्वार या सामने के दरवाजे के अंदर का स्थान या मार्ग) • **Example**: *He hurried them along the narrow, dark **hallway**__.* • **"Aisle"** means a passageway between rows of seats or a pathway in a building. (किसी इमारत में सीटों की पंक्तियों के बीच का मार्ग या रास्ता) __ • **Example**: *The stewardess came down the **aisle**__ serving drinks.* • In the given sentence, the bride and her father have arrived, and they need to clear the aisle, which means they need to walk down the pathway to reach the altar. • Synonyms of **aisle **include **hallway, passageway, corridor, pathway, and walkway.** • The correct answer is Option 2 . **Correct sentence**: *Tell everyone to clear the __**aisle**__ as the bride and her father have arrived. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Driveway (Option 1)** refers to a private road leading to a house or garage. (किसी घर या गैरेज तक जाने वाली निजी सड़क) • **Stage (Option 3)** is a raised platform where performers or speakers stand. (एक ऊँचा मंच जहाँ कलाकार या वक्ता खड़े होते हैं) • **Avenue (Option 4)** is a wide road or a tree-lined street. (चौड़ी सड़क या पेड़ों से घिरी सड़क) 31:T5be, The correct answer is **"He is a leading manufacturer in the clothing industry."**
